episodeTitle.en: What sets great teams apart | Lane Shackleton (CPO of Coda)
episodeTitle.zh: 《卓越团队的秘诀》 | 莱恩·沙克尔顿（Coda首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Lane Shackleton is CPO of Coda, where he’s been leading the product and design team for over eight years. Lane started his career as an Alaskan climbing guide and then as a manual reviewer of AdWords ads before becoming a product specialist at Google and later a Group PM at YouTube. He also writes a weekly newsletter with insights and rituals for PMs, product teams, and startups. In today’s conversation, we discuss: • Principles that set great PMs apart
guestBioOfficial.zh: 莱恩·沙克尔顿是Coda的首席产品官，已在该公司领导产品与设计团队逾八年。他职业生涯始于阿拉斯加登山向导，随后担任AdWords广告手动审核员，之后在谷歌担任产品专员，之后又在YouTube担任集团产品经理。他还每周撰写一篇通讯，为产品经理、产品团队和初创公司提供见解与实践。在今日对话中，我们将探讨：• 卓越产品经理的核心原则

title.zh: 《卓越团队的秘诀》 | 莱恩·沙克尔顿（Coda首席产品官）

summary.en: Lane argues you should actively seek "oh shit" moments - situations where you feel unqualified - because that's where real growth happens. He reframes the common "are you growing?" question into "how many stretch moments have you had lately?" The episode offers career advice on leaning into discomfort and building a foundation for the next level.
summary.zh: 莱恩认为，你应当主动去寻找"糟了"时刻——那些让你觉得自己不够格的处境——因为真正的成长就在那里发生。他把常见的"你在成长吗？"这个问题，重构为"最近你经历了多少次被拉伸的时刻？"。本期提供了关于拥抱不适感、为下一阶段打下基础的职业建议。
